requiredChecks: cd platform_v2 && npm ci && npm run build
cd platform_v2/cloudflare_shadow && npm ci && npm run check && npm run test:quick && npm run deploy:staging:dry-run
cd platform_v2/cloudflare_shadow && npm run materialize:original-ui:dry-run -- --target-env staging
notes: Cloudflare staging is the promotion gate for Cloudflare production changes.
The staging public entrypoint is Cloudflare Worker ikimon-life-cloudflare-staging, not the legacy VPS staging runtime.
The staging Worker owns staging.ikimon.life/* and uses non-production shadow D1/R2/Queue resources.
Routine Cloudflare staging deploy must not use VPS SSH, /var/www/ikimon.life-staging, or VPS_SSH_KEY.
Production Worker config must not own staging.ikimon.life routes.
Legacy VPS staging remains only for old integration jobs until those jobs are migrated or retired.
